quests.title: Go Go Saurian Expedition!

dialogue.t: Hello! Welcome to the "Saurian Expedition Supply Station."
Wow, there are many little saurians here! Are you all going out to look for Ocean Zephyrs?
Time and tide wait for no man. The Ocean Zephyr-picking squad's already left.
Though these young'uns want to help, no matter how hard Mr. Ifa and Mr. Cacucu try to teach them, they don't quite get what an Ocean Zephyr is.
To honor their enthusiasm, Mr. Ifa let them join the expedition... Although what counts as an "expedition" was left up to them.
Whether it's yummy Grainfruit or shiny trinkets, they can collect whatever they want. All that matters is that they get back safely.
Paimon gets it... Well, they sure look happy. Stay safe, little ones! The outside world's full of bad guys!
We're here to guide the little saurians along on their expedition. If you're interested, you can come check it out.

quests.description: A saurian expedition has set off in search of Ocean Zephyrs, but a few little ones seemed to have stayed behind. Why not have a chat with the staff nearby?
